modern:
Soon, very soon, you will be ashes, or a skeleton, and either a name or not even a name; but a name is sound and echo. And the things which are much valued in life are empty and rotten and trivial, like little dogs biting one another, and little children quarrelling, laughing, and then straight away crying. But faithfulness and modesty and justice and truth have fled

Up to Olympus from the wide-spread earth.

What then is there that still keeps you here, if the objects of sense are easily changed and never stand still, and the organs of perception are dull and easily receive false impressions, and the poor soul itself is a vapour rising from blood? But to have a good reputation in such a world as this is an empty thing. Why then do you not wait calmly for your end, whether it is extinction or removal to another state? And until that time comes, what is enough? Why, what else but to worship the gods and bless them, and to do good to men, and to practise tolerance and self-restraint; but as to everything which is beyond the limits of the poor flesh and breath, to remember that this is neither yours nor in your power.

Up to Olympus from the wide-spread earth.

What then is there which still detains thee here, if the objects of sense are easily changed and never stand still, and the organs of perception are dull and easily receive false impressions, and the poor soul itself is an exhalation from blood? But to have good repute amid such a world as this is an empty thing. Why then dost thou not wait in tranquillity for thy end, whether it is extinction or removal to another state? And until that time comes, what is sufficient? Why, what else than to venerate the gods and bless them, and to do good to men, and to practise tolerance and self-restraint; but as to everything which is beyond the limits of the poor flesh and breath, to remember that this is neither thine nor in thy power.

explained.summary:
Soon you’ll be ashes or bones, a name or not even that, and a name is just a sound. What people prize in life is hollow and petty, like puppies snapping at each other or children laughing one moment and crying the next. Honesty and decency seem to have left the earth.

So why cling on, or care about reputation? Wait calmly for death, whether it ends you or moves you elsewhere. Until then, enough is honouring the gods, doing good to people, putting up with them and holding back. Everything beyond your own body and breath isn’t yours and isn’t in your control.
explained.today: Think of the office squabble over who gets the window desk, or a feud in the comments over a football result. Seen from a distance they look a lot like children fighting over a toy and forgetting it ten minutes later.
